emptyHint: Select a phrase on the left or create a new one.
tip1: Type an abbreviation in any program: Phrase X replaces it with the text.
tip2: Press {key} anywhere to search and insert a phrase.
tip3: Right after an expansion, Backspace undoes it.
tip4: Type an abbreviation with a capital letter and the text starts with a capital too.
folderHint: Top-level folders act as categories. Deleting a folder also deletes its contents and subfolders.
name: Description
triggerHint: Optional: empty = menu or shortcut only
autostart: Start Phrase X when the PC starts
excludedHint: Abbreviations are not expanded in these programs (shortcuts still work).
errHotkeyUnavailable: Saved, but the shortcut is already used by another program or phrase.
errPopupHotkeyUnavailable: Saved, but the search shortcut is already used by another program.
clipHint: ↑↓ choose · Enter paste · Tab switch tab · Esc close
clipHistory: Remember copied text (last 200, password-manager items excluded)
dataHint: Every day Phrase X keeps a copy of the database (last 10). CSV columns: description; abbreviation; text.
exported: Exported to {path}. Send the file to anyone: they open it with Import.
errImportInvalid: File not recognised: use a Phrase X export (.json) or a CSV.
capitalizeSentences: Capitalize the first letter of sentences (after . ! ?)
importTitle: Import phrases from a file you received (Phrase X JSON or CSV)
exportTitle: Export all phrases to a file you can pass to other people or PCs
errFolderLoop: A folder can't be moved inside itself or one of its subfolders.
sharedTrigger: Abbreviation also used by: {names}. Typing it opens a menu to pick the phrase.
sharedHotkey: Shortcut also used by: {names}. Pressing it opens a menu to pick the phrase.
chooseHint: ↑↓ or 1-9 pick · Enter or Tab insert · Esc cancel
runAsAdminHint: Needed to expand phrases in programs running as administrator too. Windows asks for permission only when you turn this on or off; Phrase X restarts by itself.
errAdminCancelled: Administrator permission not granted: setting unchanged.
groupHint: Drag over the empty area to select several rows, or Ctrl+click. You can also drag them onto a folder. Esc cancels.
trashHint: Deleted phrases and folders stay here for 30 days, then they are deleted for good.
trashItemInfo: {kind} · deleted on {date} · removed automatically in {days} days
errImportPhraseExpress: This is an encrypted PhraseExpress file (.pexdb/.pxp) and can't be read. In PhraseExpress use Export → Text file and import the .txt.
trashGroupHint: Drag over the trash to select several rows, or Ctrl+click. Esc cancels.
syncHint: Sign in with Google to have the same library on all your PCs. Data is kept in a hidden Phrase X space on your Google Drive; if a phrase changes on two PCs, the most recent edit wins. Signing in with another Google account loads that account's library (Phrase X keeps a copy in the backups folder first).
syncLoggingIn: Finish signing in in the browser…
errGoogleNotConfigured: Google sign-in is not configured in this build (OAuth client missing, see GOOGLE-SETUP.md).
errGoogleTimeout: Sign-in not completed within 5 minutes: try again.
errGoogleRelogin: Google access expired or was revoked: click «Sign in with Google» again.
syncLinkCopied: Link copied: paste it in your browser
errGoogleScope: The Google Drive checkbox was left unticked on Google's page, so Phrase X can't save your phrases. Click «Sign in with Google» again and tick every box (or «Select all»).
